newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,478 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,478 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,478 contracts compared with 1,282 overnight Wednesday.
There were 92 wheat, 996 corn, 355 soybean, 12 oat, six soyoil, five soymeal, 11 soybean options and one corn option traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to one cent higher, corn was 1/4 to 3/4 cent lower and soybeans were 1/4 to 1-1/2 cents lower.
